title: StopAndProtect Uses Nearly 2,000 Hacked WordPress Sites to Spread Malware and Steal Data

title: Microsoft Links 30+ Rotating Domains to MacSync Stealer Infrastructure
summary: Microsoft Defender Experts have linked more than 30 web domains to MacSync Stealer, a macOS-focused information stealer, after correlating recurring endpoint and network behaviors across changing infrastructure, tracing the malware from payload retrieval through data collection, staging, and exfiltration.

title: Clop-Linked Windchill Web Shell Decrypts Credentials and Maps Engineering Data
